description: Lodge a booking REQUEST for a private (not shared-shuttle) fixed-price Queensland route — Gold Coast / Brisbane airport or Brisbane Cruise Terminal, including Byron Bay / Northern NSW. It is created as pending; the operator confirms and the customer receives a payment link by email. No payment happens through this tool. Confirm all details with the customer first. Date/time use Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (at least 1 hour ahead; same-day: phone instead)

flight.description: Flight number (optional, enables free flight tracking)

notes.description: Anything else, e.g. child seats with ages (optional)

pax.description: Passengers 1-16. Over 16 cannot be booked online - give the customer the phone number.

sandbox.description: Not supported: true is refused (this endpoint has no test mode; a request creates a real booking). Omit it.

time.description: HH:MM 24h in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving)

vehicle.description: sedan | carnival | maxi | eqb (Mercedes EQB luxury SUV, up to 3) | v300 (Mercedes V300 luxury van, up to 6) - auto-upgraded if too small for pax

name: request_booking

outputSchema.description: Lodged: ok true with the booking reference, status awaiting_payment and the payment link the customer also receives by email (duplicate true = the same request was already lodged in the last 10 minutes; nothing new was created). Sandbox connections: status sandbox_not_lodged, lodged false.

title: Request a booking
